newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday.
* President Clinton called for United Parcel Service and its Teamsters union to end the union's strike.
* The U.S. is at work on new or modified designs for nuclear arms, even though the Cold War has ended.
* Small investors do not believe the U.S. stock market is ailing, despite Friday's big selloff.
* Marion Barry's campaign for re-election Washington's mayor is under way, despite a shift of power from the Mayor to the financial control board created by Congress.
